evidence.title: AT&T settlement approved. Here's how much customers get

occurrences.checkable_against: Court-approved AT&T settlement distribution plan and settlement administrator records
occurrences.quote_span: The amounts are estimates, not guaranteed payments. Tiered payments are calculated on a pro rata basis from the remaining settlement funds after documented-loss payments and other approved expenses are paid.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: Court-approved AT&T settlement tier schedule
occurrences.quote_span: - Tier 2: $7.50 to $8.10. This is for AT&T 1 customers whose information was exposed but whose Social Security numbers were not.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: AT&T settlement plan and court-approved payment calculations
occurrences.quote_span: Customers could receive between about $6.50 and $40 through the tiered payment system, according to court documents.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: Court-approved AT&T 2 settlement terms
occurrences.quote_span: Customers in the AT&T 2 class could receive a documented-loss payment of up to $2,500 or, for eligible customers, a Tier 3 payment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: Settlement administrator claim intake records and court's final approval order
occurrences.quote_span: The settlement administrator had received 754,263 paper claims and 4,163,810 electronic claims, for a total of 4,918,073 claims.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: Court docket objections in the AT&T settlement and final settlement record in the T-Mobile litigation
occurrences.quote_span: The settlement faced dozens of objections, including arguments that the amount was inadequate compared to a $350 million settlement in separate litigation involving T-Mobile.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: AT&T settlement website claims rules
occurrences.quote_span: The settlement website says qualifying losses could include certain expenses related to fraud or identity theft, while some losses, including medical bills, emotional distress and estimated lost wages, were not eligible.
occurrences.speaker: AT&T settlement website
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: Court-approved AT&T settlement tier schedule
occurrences.quote_span: - Tier 3: $6.50 to $7.10. This is for eligible AT&T 2 customers whose information was exposed in the second data incident.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: Settlement administrator payment calculations and final distribution records
occurrences.quote_span: Most customers receiving the tiered cash payments are expected to get far less than the settlement's advertised maximums.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: Court-approved AT&T settlement tier schedule
occurrences.quote_span: - Tier 1: $39 to $40. This is for AT&T 1 customers whose Social Security numbers were exposed.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: Court-approved AT&T 1 settlement terms
occurrences.quote_span: Customers in the AT&T 1 settlement class could receive either a documented-loss payment of up to $5,000 or a tiered cash payment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: Settlement administrator's claim classification records
occurrences.quote_span: CT Insider reported that 1,654,046 claims were classified as Tier 1, 687,859 as Tier 2 and 1,582,248 as Tier 3.
occurrences.speaker: CT Insider
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: AT&T statements and settlement agreement in the AT&T data breach litigation
occurrences.quote_span: AT&T has denied wrongdoing and previously told Reuters that it agreed to settle to avoid the expense and uncertainty of prolonged litigation.
occurrences.speaker: AT&T
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. District Court final approval order for the AT&T data breach settlement
occurrences.quote_span: A federal judge has granted final approval to AT&T's $177 million settlement resolving lawsuits over two 2024 data breaches that exposed personal information belonging to millions of customers.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: Court's final approval order for the AT&T data breach settlement
occurrences.quote_span: Nearly 5 million claim forms had been submitted as of Aug. 24, 2026, according to the court's final approval order.
occurrences.speaker: court's final approval order
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: Court-approved AT&T settlement allocation and fund accounts
occurrences.quote_span: The settlement has two funds totaling $177 million: $149 million for customers affected by the first data incident, known as AT&T 1, and $28 million for customers affected by the second incident, known as AT&T 2.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: AT&T settlement website payment schedule and claims administration records
occurrences.quote_span: Payments will be distributed after the appeals period has expired and settlement administrators have completed their review of claims, according to the settlement website.
occurrences.speaker: AT&T settlement website
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: AT&T settlement claim requirements and court-approved claims procedure
occurrences.quote_span: Customers seeking compensation for documented losses had to provide evidence that the losses were "fairly traceable" to a data incident.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: Settlement administrator distribution records and court-approved settlement plan
occurrences.quote_span: The settlement administrator will first pay approved documented-loss claims from the applicable net settlement funds. Remaining money will then be distributed to eligible claimants through the tiered payment system.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. District Court final approval order and fee award in the AT&T data breach litigation
occurrences.quote_span: U.S. District Judge Sidney Fitzwater in Dallas approved the settlement Oct. 2, along with $59 million in attorneys' fees for lawyers who negotiated the deal, according to Reuters.
occurrences.speaker: Reuters
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement

occurrences.checkable_against: Court-approved AT&T settlement eligibility and payment rules
occurrences.quote_span: For AT&T customers who filed valid claims, the amount they receive depends on which data breach affected them, what information was exposed and whether they can document financial losses.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: AT&T data breach settlement
